A bewitching race of beastmen with an upper body like that of a hume woman and a lower body resembling that of a venomous serpent, known for enthralling townspeople and crafting magic jewelry.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Lamias gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Charisma, and -2 Strength.
  • Size: Lamias are Medium creatures.
  • Type: Lamias are Humanoid creatures with the reptilian subtype.
  • Base Speed: Lamias have a base speed of 20 feet and a swim speed of 40 feet, never modified by armor or encumbrance.
  • Languages: Lamias begin play speaking Common and Aquan. Lamias with high Intelligence scores can choose from: Aboleth, Aklo, Draconic, Elvaan, Sahagin, and Sylvan.

Defense Racial Traits

  • Bond to the Land: Lamias gain a +2 dodge bonus to AC when fighting in desert or water areas.
  • Hold Breath: Lamias can hold their breath for 4x their Constitution score in rounds.
  • Tough Scales: Lamias gain a +1 natural armor bonus.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Jeweler's Craft: Lamias gain a +2 racial bonus on Craft or Profession checks to create objects from metal.

Offense Racial Traits

  • Slapping Tail: Lamias can use their tails to make attacks of opportunity with 5-foot reach, dealing 1d8 plus Strength modifier.
  • Tripping Tail: When lamias hit with their slapping tail, they can make a free trip attempt without provoking attacks of opportunity.
  • Weapon Familiarity: Lamias are proficient with scimitar and cutlass.

Senses Racial Traits

  • Low-Light Vision: Lamias have low-light vision.

Weakness Racial Traits

  • Legless: Lamias cannot equip leg or foot armor/items, but can wear two neck slot items.
